visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Odd Case Forgets the Base
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 2 to the power of 10 should print 1024, but the program prints 1.

solution.explanation: When the exponent is odd, squaring the half loses one factor of the base, so it must be multiplied in again. Without it every odd step produces 1, and the error propagates to every result built on top of it.
